p.seg: Heaven creates Earth among the 万物，and certainly the 圣人 among the creatures in 万物. The agent behind the function of 地 remains 天. 地 is not being attribute agency. On the other hand among the 人 the 圣人 is attributed agency, being the originator of the successful completion of that creation by Heaven.
this is what 仁義 治s

On the modality of rozhdaet: 1. The Temporal Logic: Perpetual vs. PunctualРождает (Imperfective): Logically, this denotes an action without a "cap" or a terminal boundary. In the sentence Небо рождает..., the imperfective aspect signals that the "birthing" is a constant state. It is happening right now, it happened yesterday, and it will happen tomorrow.Literal logical reading: "Heaven is in a perpetual state of generating the ten thousand things." Родит (Perfective): The perfective implies a one-time result. If the text said Небо родит..., it would sound like a prophecy or a specific historical event (e.g., "Heaven will give birth to..."). It would imply that once the ten thousand things are born, the act is finished (A→B=Done). 2. 万物 “the myriad kinds of things": they are infinitely more than ten thousand kind.
